{{Infobox map |name=Joi Zite |year=2023 |image=Zite_mini1.jpg |creator={{player|alice|flag=se}} |gametype=1on1 |size=small |download=https://maps.quakeworld.nu/all/zite.bsp |loc= }} '''Zite''' is a 1on1 / 2on2 map by {{player|alice|flag=se}}, which is an updated version of [[Zeit]], where the fixes only concern the YA area. Balance tweaks: * YA and cell pack has swapped position. * In addition, the YA area is more open with higher ceiling * One pillar removed from the YA area. * The previous boxes are replaced with a more convenient ramp.
The layout offer plenty of verticality and geometry for fast paced combat maneuvers. The map is very sparse of cell ammounition, with only 2 small packs of a total of 12 cells.
